overview: Git Commit Prompt Pack is a digital collection of 40 engineered prompts designed to force LLMs to generate strictly conventional commit messages. It targets developers who need consistent, machine-readable history without manually enforcing style guides in every interaction.
usecases: Automating changelog generation by ensuring every commit follows the Conventional Commits specification.
Standardizing commit messages across a team using different AI assistants or local models.
Generating accurate breaking-change flags for monorepo packages to simplify release management.
howto: Download the ZIP file and extract the markdown prompt files to your local directory.
Copy the specific prompt template into your LLM interface and replace the placeholder variables with your code diff or change summary.
Paste the generated output into your git commit message field, verifying the scope and breaking-change indicators before pushing.

faq.q: Does this guarantee my LLM will never make a mistake?
faq.a: No, it significantly reduces errors by providing strict structural constraints, but you must still review the output for semantic accuracy.

faq.q: Is this compatible with any AI model?
faq.a: Yes, the prompts are model-agnostic and work with any LLM that supports system or user instructions, though performance may vary slightly between models.
